nb2_lite.texto: A photograph of the same person shown in the reference image. A mid-20s Spanish man, olive skin, black hair, lean build, in a dust-coated singlet and shorts, one foot bandaged. He sits on the step of a corrugated-iron house, waiting, as fine mill dust drifts through the air around him. Spanish people with olive to fair Mediterranean skin, dark brown to black hair and brown eyes. A Wittenoom house yard in 1963, blue tailings ground, red earth, mill haze over the gorge. Hard backlit afternoon sun making the airborne dust glitter. Close shot, eye-level, slightly low, shallow depth of field, 85mm lens, dust particles in focus. A grainy 35mm documentary photograph in the style of 1963, with muted colors and slight underexposure, in a dark-history realist style. The image has a 16:9 aspect ratio. No readable text, no signage, no labels.
